qualityMatcher: UTF-16 prefix 4F20 8BF4 (legendary) / 53F2 8BD7 (epic) / 7A00 6709 (rare) / 666E 901A (common), then 00B7 or 30FB; skip whitespace and leading tags
effect: Effects scale with quality (common: faint glint; rare: flowing blue + glint + breathing blue glow; epic: dark violet body, glint, purple rim, two orbiting purple shadows, haze, sparse sparkles); legendary is Calamity-style burnished gold: dark crimson (or gold) per-glyph body with a soft wide ((sin+1)/2)^24 glint on glyphs only (epic too; common/rare keep ^120), ~3.3 s eased 0.5 s gleam mostly on the rim and heat glow, gold rim + heat glow + two upward flame drop shadows + bloom filters, additive aura and CosmicPurple-style rising rotating cross sparkles
